meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一段文字或笔记做成无人出镜的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿,想让没有实拍画面的内容变成能发布的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn written text or notes into an explainer video with no on-camera presenter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have written content and want a publishable video without filming anything.

howto.what: 把一段文字（文章、笔记、主题、简介）做成无人出镜的解说视频：画面按每个场景自行设计排版、抽象图形、图表和数据可视化，不抓取网站也没有实拍素材。流程产出 STORYBOARD.md、SCRIPT.md，最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想把一篇文章、一份笔记或一个主题做成解说视频时用它（主题解说、概念拆解、操作教程等）。若要基于网站做推广或导览，或意图不明，应先走 /hyperframes。

say.note: 先给出分镜方案，等你确认后再搭建

howto.what_en: Turns a body of text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video. Visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz); nothing is captured. It produces STORYBOARD.md, SCRIPT.md and renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want an article, notes or a topic turned into a video (topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles). For a video built from a website, or when intent is unclear, go to /hyperframes first.
